text:
In the tree of my chest
there is a scarlet bird.
When I see you, it startles,
flutters, leaps about.

In the tree of my chest
there is a scarlet bird.
When I see you, it startles:
you are a scarecrow!

translation.title: In the Tree of My Chest

Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.
